column1: # European Portuguese (pt-pt) catalog, PeDeeFe's own. Format: see the header of ja.tsv
# (context <TAB> source <TAB> translation; @id, @plural and other contexts; escapes \n \t \\).
# Plural forms (see `plural_one_other` in i18n/mod.rs): one (1) | other (0, 2, 3 ...).
# Clean-room: every entry was written from the plain meaning of the English label using ordinary
# European Portuguese computing vocabulary (post-1990 spelling). No proprietary localisation
# resource, string table or product UI (Acrobat's included) was consulted or copied; add entries
# House style, so the interface reads as one voice:
# - Portugal, not Brazil: Ficheiro, Guardar, Ecrã, Transferir, Utilizador, Definições, Eliminar,
#   palavra-passe, ligação (link), separador (tab), rato, premir, carateres, ecrã inteiro.
# - Commands and buttons in the infinitive (Abrir, Guardar como…, Imprimir); instructions to the
#   user in the polite imperative (Clique, Escolha, Introduza, Arraste).
# - Fixed terms: Anular/Refazer, Localizar (find), Pesquisar (search), Rodar, Ampliar/Reduzir,
#   Recortar (crop) vs Cortar (cut), Rasurado (strikethrough), Ocultar (redact), Achatar
#   (flatten), Carimbo (stamp), Nota adesiva, Marcador (bookmark), Miniatura, Cartaz (poster),
#   Folheto (booklet), Frente e verso, Escala de cinzentos, ppp (dpi).
# Product and technology names (PeDeeFe, PdfCraft, PDF, Acrobat JavaScript ...) are not
# translated; the trailing "…" of dialog commands is kept.
